save_size.description: Save figure size in pixels. Default is 2000 2000.
save_size.title: Save Size

title.description: Graph title. File name is used by default. Use NONE to be sure no title is used.
title.title: Graph Title

input_type.description: Type of data in 1D file. Choose from 'VOLREG' or 'XMAT'.
input_type.title: Input Type

left_y_margin_text.description: Text to be placed at left Y margin. You need one string per column.
left_y_margin_text.title: Left Y Margin Text

right_y_margin_text.description: Text to be placed at right Y margin. You need one string per column.
right_y_margin_text.title: Right Y Margin Text

x_axis_range.description: Range of X axis. STEP is optional.
x_axis_range.title: X Axis Range

y_axis_range.description: Range of Y axis. STEP is optional.
y_axis_range.title: Y Axis Range

plot_char.description: Symbols for each column in input.
plot_char.title: Plot Character

group_labels.description: Legends assigned to each group. Default is no labeling.
group_labels.title: Group Labels

legend_position.description: Legend position. Choose from: bottomright, bottom, bottomleft, left, topleft, top, topright, right, center.
legend_position.title: Legend Position

save_plot.description: Save plot and quit. No need for -prefix with this option.
save_plot.title: Save Plot

column_name_show.description: Show names of column in input.
column_name_show.title: Show Column Names
